scope: Original requirement 116 conditional applicability only. No virtualized/windowed record rendering found in current source. This immutable source-backed decision is not general accessibility acceptance or new runtime evidence.
requirement: Provide accessible nonvirtualized summaries or navigation where virtualization would otherwise hide content from assistive technology.
procedural_exception: Applies only where virtualization is actually used. A source-backed finding that no virtualization exists is a valid not-triggered disposition, not a demand to introduce virtualization.

source_inventory.scope_limit: Inventory covers current repository-owned frontend source. Installed tool internals, deployed runtime behavior and future generated source are not certified.

actual_source_behavior_review.finding: Analysis uses explicit page selection and native Previous/Next controls with page and record counts, rather than viewport windowing.
Unit board constructs a complete matched index set, slices only by explicit page state, and offers native Previous/Next controls with count status. Full matched indexes remain available for print.

Member lists use explicit expandable disclosure with Show next/Show all/Show fewer; native buttons retain meaningful names/count descriptions. All displayed rows are generated from member HTML with actual identity links.
Full unit member identity and destination remain in each member chip through data-open-member; this is not an index-only visual row.
Printing materializes complete matching member lists and restores prior live nodes, rather than viewport-only rows.
Main unit board binds full unitAssignments index set to explicit rendering and carries page state.

scroll_candidate_dispositions.interpretation: Current profile rail cue reads overflow/direction and scrolls already-present tab elements into view. Identity heading overflow adds a keyboard stop; workspace maintains panel scroll and visual viewport fit. Neither rail nor profile rows are windowed or replaced by viewport-index ranges.

Capture/restore scroll and focus after renders; analysis tab reveal; table overflow labeling; these preserve/label existing content. Explicit paginate helper depends on selected page, not scroll position. Fixed-count summaries are summaries/disclosures, not virtual windows.
Scroll/resize observations position the expanded connection-status panel; they do not trim or generate record ranges.
Bounded MutationObserver waits for real content then restores route scroll once; no windowed list rendering.
ResizeObserver/requestAnimationFrame adapts sticky save dock to viewport height; no record windowing.
Dialog/form scroll reset or restoration; no viewport-dependent record inclusion.
Responsive overflow, layouts, hover transforms and animation transforms style existing DOM; no row spacers or content-visibility/windowing implementation.

conditions.condition: Any virtualized content has a usable nonvirtualized summary or navigation path covering records hidden by windowing.
conditions.rationale: The requirement applies where virtualization hides record DOM. Source inventory, dependency/import inspection, explicit pagination/disclosure call paths and reviewed scroll candidates establish no such current implementation. Its procedural exception expressly permits this source-backed disposition; no alternative virtual-list summary is required.

conditions.condition: That path preserves meaningful record identity, counts and reachable destinations.
conditions.rationale: No virtualized-content alternative path is needed. Existing explicit unit pagination/disclosure retains actual member identity links, full matched indexes/counts and native page/expand controls. These supporting facts are source evidence, not a substitute claim of all assistive-technology/runtime coverage.

historical_supplement.scope: Historical desktop Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, computer_admin/rota_board_member, 123 intercepted postings; no writes. Each recorded case reaches all ordered rows.
historical_supplement.freshness: unit-board-filters.ts recorded hash still current; main.ts whole-file hash differs. Historical report is supplemental, not a new current runtime execution or an acceptance dependency for the no-virtualization finding.

limitations: Root must independently adjudicate exact requirement acceptance; this snapshot does not change ledger status.
A negative keyword search alone is not proof; disposition also uses actual pagination/disclosure implementation, dependencies/imports and scroll candidate interpretation.
Native screen-reader, physical-device, full pagination semantics and general accessibility requirements retain their separate pending scopes.
Any future virtualization introduction invalidates this not-triggered disposition and must provide the originally required alternative access path.
